Bun + TypeScript vs uv + Python 性能实测报告

测量时间：2026-08-03 09:59 UTC+8 ｜ 全部数据由本文末尾内嵌的脚本实测产出，无引用外部数据。

本文自包含：包含完整方法论、原始结果、结论，以及可复现全部测量的全部源码（40 个文件）。

摘要​

结论一句话：Bun 在纯计算上快 15–20 倍、HTTP 吞吐高 5.2 倍，代价是约 1.9 倍的常驻内存；但只要 Python 用上 C 扩展（NumPy 快 14 倍）或场景由 syscall 主导（文件 IO 打平），优势立即消失甚至反转。

维度赢家幅度
纯 CPU 计算Bun14.8× ~ 20.0×
HTTP 吞吐Bun5.16×
文件 IO打平1.00×
数值计算（NumPy）Python14.2×
内存占用Python基线 1.9×，峰值最高 2.3×
依赖安装uv（略胜）1.20×

选型建议直接看文末权衡建议。

方法论​

  • 样本：每个场景每个运行时预热 3 次、正式测量 10 次，正文表格报告中位数（对偶发抖动比均值稳健）。完整分布（min/median/mean/stddev/max）见文末附录 A。注意本框架保存的是聚合统计量，未保留逐次样本，故无法事后做分布图或显著性检验。
  • 三个运行时：bun（Bun + TypeScript）、uv run（真实工作流入口）、venv python（.venv/bin/python，纯解释器）。分开测是为了剥离 uv 包装器自身的开销。
  • 两种计时：
    • 墙钟总耗时 — 父进程从 spawn 到 exit，含运行时启动，对应真实调用一次脚本的体感。
    • 纯计算耗时 — 被测脚本内部用 performance.now() / time.perf_counter() 自计时，排除启动，衡量语言执行效率。
  • 内存：父进程通过 Subprocess.resourceUsage().maxRSS 读取子进程峰值 RSS，语言中立（不依赖被测语言自报，避免两侧统计口径不同）。
  • 公平性约束：两侧使用同一个 xorshift32 PRNG（同种子）生成完全相同的输入数据；算法逐行对应，不允许一侧走捷径。

正确性保障（关键）​

性能对比最常见的失效模式是两侧其实算了不同的东西。因此每个被测脚本除耗时外必须输出一个 checksum，src/verify.ts 校验其跨三个运行时完全一致：

✓ startup        checksum=0
✓ primes         checksum=148935446792

✓ strings        checksum=57201127277
✓ fileio         checksum=1032890
✓ matmul_pure    checksum=122869563
✓ matmul_numpy   checksum=122869563

本次结果：跨运行时 checksum 全部一致 ✓；NumPy 结果与纯实现一致 ✓（同为 122869563，证明 BLAS 路径没有偷工）。

关键发现​

  1. 纯解释执行差距 15–20 倍，但绝对值都很小（83.8 ms vs 5.66 ms）。脚本级任务中这点差距常被启动开销和 IO 淹没——先确认瓶颈真在 CPU 再谈换语言。

  2. NumPy 让差距反转 14.2 倍：0.39 ms vs Bun 手写 Float64Array 三重循环的 5.46 ms。同一份 checksum 证明两者算的是同一个矩阵积。选对库比选对语言影响大得多。

  3. 文件 IO 完全打平（比值 1.00×）：2000 次小文件读写由 syscall 支配，运行时几乎无影响。

  4. uv run 的包装开销约 6ms/次（21.5 ms vs 15.6 ms），每次调用都要付。CI 里高频短命令建议直接用 .venv/bin/python。

  5. 启动开销 Bun 只快 3.9ms（11.7 ms vs 15.6 ms），远不如常见说法那么悬殊。

  6. 内存全面反转：Bun 是 Python 的 1.9–2.3 倍。 空脚本基线 27.9 MB vs 14.6 MB——JSC 堆加 Bun 运行时的固定成本，任务再小也要付。

  7. 字符串场景内存差距最大（130.6 MB vs 56.9 MB）。该场景 split 出约 80 万个短字符串对象；差距方向符合"JS 小对象头开销大于 CPython str"的预期，但成因未单独测量验证，属推断。

  8. uv run 内存列有 19.7 MB 的地板：startup / 素数筛 / 文件 IO / 纯矩阵四个场景数值完全相同，说明峰值由 uv 自身的 Rust 二进制决定而非 Python。要看 Python 真实占用请只读 venv python 列。

  9. 常驻服务是 Bun 内存劣势最小的场景：35.9 MB vs 30.7 MB（仅 1.17×），而吞吐差 5.16×。折算单位吞吐的内存成本，Bun 反而省 4.4 倍。同时 p99 延迟 1.47 ms vs 8.76 ms。

  10. 包管理器 uv 略快于 bun（24.5 ms vs 29.5 ms），且 uv 还多解析安装了 26 个传递依赖（bun 那三个包零依赖）。两者都在 30ms 级，实践中不构成差异。

  11. 生态兼容性是隐藏成本：原计划测 pydantic==2.9.2，但 pydantic-core 2.23.4 无 cp314 wheel，uv 回退到源码编译 Rust 扩展，68 秒后失败。故改用两侧对称的纯语言包。这类问题对实际开发速度的影响远大于运行时性能差异。

权衡建议​

Bun 用约 1.9 倍内存换来 15–20 倍 CPU 速度。据此分场景：

场景建议理由
CPU 密集、高并发 HTTP 服务Bun5× 吞吐、p99 更低；内存劣势被吞吐摊薄后反而更省
内存受限（小规格容器、大量并行进程、低内存 Lambda 档）Python14.6 MB vs 27.9 MB 基线；跑 100 个进程就是 1.3 GB 的差距
数值计算 / 数据处理Python + NumPy时间和内存双赢，无需犹豫
文件/网络 IO 为主的胶水脚本都行，按团队技能选瓶颈在 syscall，运行时无关
短命令高频调用（CI 钩子等）Bun，或 Python 绕开 uv runBun 启动 12ms；用 Python 则直连 .venv/bin/python 省下包装开销

局限与注意事项​

诚实标注本次测量的边界，避免过度外推：

  1. 素数筛与纯矩阵乘法刻意使用逐元素循环以保证两侧算法严格一致。Python 惯用的切片赋值 / NumPy 向量化会快得多（见发现 2），因此这两项不代表 Python 工程实践的真实性能上限，只代表解释器执行效率。
  2. 依赖安装为热缓存，未清空全局 cache（那会影响使用者环境）。冷缓存下网络下载将主导耗时，结论可能不同。
  3. uvicorn 为单进程，未启用多 worker。生产环境通常配合多进程，吞吐可近似随核数扩展；Bun.serve 单进程即多核处理连接，此项对 Python 偏保守。
  4. 压测客户端与服务端同机，客户端（Bun fetch，64 并发）本身消耗 CPU，两侧同等受影响，但绝对吞吐低于专用压测机的结果。
  5. 单机单次会话测量，未跨机器/多日重复，未做统计显著性检验。数量级结论可靠，个位数百分比差异不应过度解读——例如文件 IO 本轮为 1.00×，而先前一轮同样配置测得 0.94×，这个量级的波动属噪声。
  6. JIT 预热：Bun 预热 3 次已进入稳态；长时间运行的服务中 JIT 优势可能更大，短脚本中更小。

复现步骤​

# 1. 准备环境
bun install
uv sync                      # Python 3.14 + numpy + uvicorn

# 2. 先验正确性（必须全部 ✓ 才有对比意义）
bun run src/verify.ts

# 3. 依次测量
bun run src/main.ts          # 7 场景 × 3 运行时 × 时间/内存
bun run src/http_main.ts     # HTTP 吞吐 + 服务器内存
bun run src/install_main.ts  # 包管理器

# 4. 重新生成本报告
bun run src/gen_report.ts

测量期间请勿运行其他重负载任务，否则 CPU 争用会污染结果。四条命令均已实测执行通过。

测量框架​

measure.ts 负责计时与内存采集，verify.ts 负责 checksum 校验，report.ts 负责表格渲染。

src/config.ts — 56 行
export type Lang = "ts" | "py";

export interface RuntimeSpec {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  lang: Lang;
  cmd: string[];
}

export interface CaseSpec {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  ts_script: string;
  py_script: string;
  scale: number;
  unit: string;
}

export interface RunnerSpec {
  warmup_runs: number;
  measure_runs: number;
  timeout_ms: number;
  tmp_dir: string;
}

export interface HttpSpec {
  port_ts: number;
  port_py: number;
  boot_wait_ms: number;
  duration_s: number;
  concurrency: number;
  payload_bytes: number;
}

export interface InstallSpec {
  runs: number;
  ts_packages: string[];
  py_packages: string[];
}

export interface Config {
  runner: RunnerSpec;
  python: { version: string };
  runtimes: RuntimeSpec[];
  http: HttpSpec;
  install: InstallSpec;
  cases: CaseSpec[];
}

export async function loadConfig(path = "bench.yaml"): Promise<Config> {
  return Bun.YAML.parse(await Bun.file(path).text()) as Config;
}

export function scriptFor(runtime: RuntimeSpec, spec: CaseSpec): string {
  return runtime.lang === "ts"
    ? `cases/ts/${spec.ts_script}`
    : `cases/py/${spec.py_script}`;
}
src/main.ts — 86 行
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { loadConfig, scriptFor, type CaseSpec } from "./config";
import { measure, type Aggregate } from "./measure";
import { buildCoreTable, fmtBytes } from "./report";

const config = await loadConfig();
mkdirSync(config.runner.tmp_dir, { recursive: true });
mkdirSync("results", { recursive: true });

const data = new Map<string, Aggregate>();
const mismatches: string[] = [];

function argsFor(spec: CaseSpec): string[] {
  return [String(spec.scale), config.runner.tmp_dir];
}

function checkChecksums(spec: CaseSpec): void {
  const seen = config.runtimes
    .map((rt) => data.get(`${rt.id}:${spec.id}`))
    .filter((agg): agg is Aggregate => agg !== undefined);
  const distinct = new Set(seen.map((agg) => agg.checksum));
  if (distinct.size > 1) {
    mismatches.push(`${spec.id}: ${[...distinct].join(" vs ")}`);
  }
}

for (const spec of config.cases) {
  process.stderr.write(
    `\n▶ ${spec.label} (scale=${spec.scale} ${spec.unit})\n`,
  );
  for (const runtime of config.runtimes) {
    const script = scriptFor(runtime, spec);
    try {
      const agg = await measure(
        runtime,
        spec.id,
        script,
        argsFor(spec),
        config.runner,
      );
      data.set(`${runtime.id}:${spec.id}`, agg);
      process.stderr.write(
        `   ${runtime.id.padEnd(10)} wall=${agg.wall.median.toFixed(1)}ms ` +
          `compute=${agg.compute.median.toFixed(1)}ms rss=${fmtBytes(agg.rss.median)} ` +
          `checksum=${agg.checksum}\n`,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      process.stderr.write(
        `   ${runtime.id.padEnd(10)} 失败: ${(error as Error).message}\n`,
      );
    }
  }
  checkChecksums(spec);
}

const crossMatmul =
  data.get("bun:matmul_pure")?.checksum ===
  data.get("py_direct:matmul_numpy")?.checksum;

const output = [
  "## 墙钟总耗时（含解释器/运行时启动）",
  "",
  buildCoreTable(config.cases, config.runtimes, data, "wall"),
  "",
  "## 纯计算耗时（脚本内部自计时，排除启动）",
  "",
  buildCoreTable(config.cases, config.runtimes, data, "compute"),
  "",
  "## 峰值内存 RSS（父进程 rusage 观测，语言中立）",
  "",
  buildCoreTable(config.cases, config.runtimes, data, "rss", fmtBytes),
  "",
  `校验：跨运行时 checksum ${mismatches.length === 0 ? "全部一致 ✓" : "不一致 ✗ " + mismatches.join("; ")}`,
  `校验：NumPy 结果与纯实现一致 ${crossMatmul ? "✓" : "✗"}`,
].join("\n");

console.log(output);

await Bun.write(
  "results/core.json",
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      meta: {
        generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        warmup_runs: config.runner.warmup_runs,
        measure_runs: config.runner.measure_runs,
        checksum_ok: mismatches.length === 0,
        numpy_matches_pure: crossMatmul,
      },
      cases: config.cases,

import type { RunnerSpec, RuntimeSpec } from "./config";
import { summarize, type Stats } from "./stats";

export interface Sample {
  wallMs: number;
  computeMs: number;
  checksum: number;
  rssBytes: number;
}

export interface Aggregate {
  runtimeId: string;
  caseId: string;
  wall: Stats;
  compute: Stats;
  rss: Stats;
  checksum: number;
  runs: number;
}

export async function runOnce(
  runtime: RuntimeSpec,
  script: string,
  args: string[],
  timeoutMs: number,
): Promise<Sample> {
  const argv = [...runtime.cmd, script, ...args];
  const started = performance.now();
  const proc = Bun.spawn(argv, { stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
  const killer = setTimeout(() => proc.kill(9), timeoutMs);
  const [out, err, code] = await Promise.all([
    new Response(proc.stdout).text(),
    new Response(proc.stderr).text(),
    proc.exited,
  ]);
  clearTimeout(killer);
  const wallMs = performance.now() - started;
  const rssBytes = proc.resourceUsage()?.maxRSS ?? 0;
  if (code !== 0) {
    throw new Error(`${argv.join(" ")} 退出码 ${code}\n${err.trim()}`);
  }
  const parsed = JSON.parse(out.trim()) as {
    checksum: number;
    computeMs: number;
  };
  return {
    wallMs,
    computeMs: parsed.computeMs,
    checksum: parsed.checksum,
    rssBytes,
  };
}

export async function measure(
  runtime: RuntimeSpec,
  caseId: string,
  script: string,
  args: string[],
  runner: RunnerSpec,
): Promise<Aggregate> {
  for (let i = 0; i < runner.warmup_runs; i++) {
    await runOnce(runtime, script, args, runner.timeout_ms);
  }
  const samples: Sample[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < runner.measure_runs; i++) {
    samples.push(await runOnce(runtime, script, args, runner.timeout_ms));
  }
  return {
    runtimeId: runtime.id,
    caseId,
    wall: summarize(samples.map((s) => s.wallMs)),
    compute: summarize(samples.map((s) => s.computeMs)),
    rss: summarize(samples.map((s) => s.rssBytes)),
    checksum: samples[0].checksum,
    runs: samples.length,
  };
}

import type { CaseSpec, RuntimeSpec } from "./config";
import type { Aggregate } from "./measure";

const WIDE_RANGES: [number, number][] = [
  [0x1100, 0x115f],
  [0x2e80, 0x303e],
  [0x3041, 0x33ff],
  [0x3400, 0x4dbf],
  [0x4e00, 0x9fff],
  [0xa000, 0xa4cf],
  [0xac00, 0xd7a3],
  [0xf900, 0xfaff],
  [0xfe30, 0xfe4f],
  [0xff00, 0xff60],
  [0xffe0, 0xffe6],
];

function isWide(codePoint: number): boolean {
  return WIDE_RANGES.some(([lo, hi]) => codePoint >= lo && codePoint <= hi);
}

export function displayWidth(text: string): number {
  let width = 0;
  for (const ch of text) width += isWide(ch.codePointAt(0) ?? 0) ? 2 : 1;
  return width;
}

export function pad(
  text: string,
  target: number,
  align: "left" | "right" = "left",
): string {
  const gap = Math.max(0, target - displayWidth(text));
  return align === "left" ? text + " ".repeat(gap) : " ".repeat(gap) + text;
}

export function fmtMs(ms: number): string {
  if (ms >= 1000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`;
  if (ms >= 10) return `${ms.toFixed(1)} ms`;
  return `${ms.toFixed(2)} ms`;
}

export function renderTable(
  rows: string[][],
  aligns: ("left" | "right")[],
): string {
  const widths = rows[0].map((_, col) =>
    Math.max(...rows.map((r) => displayWidth(r[col] ?? ""))),
  );
  const line = (cells: string[]) =>
    "| " + cells.map((c, i) => pad(c, widths[i], aligns[i])).join(" | ") + " |";
  const sep = "|" + widths.map((w) => "-".repeat(w + 2)).join("|") + "|";
  return [line(rows[0]), sep, ...rows.slice(1).map(line)].join("\n");
}

export function fmtBytes(bytes: number): string {
  return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

export function buildCoreTable(
  cases: CaseSpec[],
  runtimes: RuntimeSpec[],
  data: Map<string, Aggregate>,
  metric: "wall" | "compute" | "rss",
  format: (value: number) => string = fmtMs,
): string {
  const header = ["场景", ...runtimes.map((r) => r.label), "Py/Bun"];
  const rows = [header];
  for (const spec of cases) {
    const cells = [spec.label];
    for (const rt of runtimes) {
      const agg = data.get(`${rt.id}:${spec.id}`);
      cells.push(agg ? format(agg[metric].median) : "—");
    }
    const bun = data.get(`bun:${spec.id}`)?.[metric].median;
    const py = data.get(`py_direct:${spec.id}`)?.[metric].median;
    cells.push(bun && py && bun > 0 ? `${(py / bun).toFixed(2)}×` : "—");
    rows.push(cells);
  }
  return renderTable(rows, [
    "left",
    ...runtimes.map(() => "right" as const),
    "right",
  ]);
}

export interface Stats {
  min: number;
  median: number;
  mean: number;
  stddev: number;
  max: number;
}

export function summarize(values: number[]): Stats {
  const sorted = [...values].sort((x, y) => x - y);
  const mean = sorted.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0) / sorted.length;
  const variance =
    sorted.reduce((acc, v) => acc + (v - mean) ** 2, 0) / sorted.length;
  return {
    min: sorted[0],
    median: percentile(sorted, 0.5),
    mean,
    stddev: Math.sqrt(variance),
    max: sorted[sorted.length - 1],
  };
}

function percentile(sorted: number[], q: number): number {
  const pos = (sorted.length - 1) * q;
  const lo = Math.floor(pos);
  const hi = Math.ceil(pos);
  return lo === hi
    ? sorted[lo]
    : sorted[lo] + (sorted[hi] - sorted[lo]) * (pos - lo);
}

import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { loadConfig, scriptFor } from "./config";
import { runOnce } from "./measure";

const config = await loadConfig();
mkdirSync(config.runner.tmp_dir, { recursive: true });

let failures = 0;

for (const spec of config.cases) {
  const seen: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const runtime of config.runtimes) {
    const sample = await runOnce(
      runtime,
      scriptFor(runtime, spec),
      [String(spec.scale), config.runner.tmp_dir],
      config.runner.timeout_ms,
    );
    seen[runtime.id] = sample.checksum;
  }
  const distinct = new Set(Object.values(seen));
  const ok = distinct.size === 1;
  if (!ok) failures++;
  const detail = ok
    ? `checksum=${Object.values(seen)[0]}`
    : Object.entries(seen)
        .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
        .join(" ");
  console.log(`${ok ? "✓" : "✗"} ${spec.id.padEnd(14)} ${detail}`);
}

console.log(failures === 0 ? "\n全部一致" : `\n${failures} 个场景不一致`);
process.exit(failures === 0 ? 0 : 1);

import { scaleArg, timed } from "./lib/emit";
import { makeRng } from "./lib/rng";

const NAME_CHARS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";

timed(() => {
  const n = scaleArg();
  const rng = makeRng(12345);
  const rows: unknown[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let name = "";
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) name += NAME_CHARS[rng() % 26];
    rows.push({
      id: i,
      name,
      score: rng() % 10000,
      tags: [TAG_POOL[rng() % 5], TAG_POOL[rng() % 5]],
      active: rng() % 2 === 0,
    });
  }
  const text = JSON.stringify(rows);
  const back = JSON.parse(text) as { score: number }[];
  let total = 0;
  for (const row of back) total += row.score;
  return total * 31 + text.length;
});

export function emit(checksum: number, computeMs: number): void {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ checksum, computeMs }));
}

export function scaleArg(): number {
  return Number(process.argv[2] ?? 0);
}

export function tmpArg(): string {
  return process.argv[3] ?? ".bench-tmp";
}

export function timed(work: () => number): void {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const checksum = work();
  emit(checksum, performance.now() - t0);
}
cases/ts/lib/rng.ts — 9 行
export function makeRng(seed: number): () => number {
  let x = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    x = (x ^ (x << 13)) >>> 0;
    x = (x ^ (x >>> 17)) >>> 0;
    x = (x ^ (x << 5)) >>> 0;
    return x;
  };
}

import { scaleArg, timed } from "./lib/emit";

timed(() => {
  const n = scaleArg();
  const a = new Float64Array(n * n);
  const b = new Float64Array(n * n);
  const c = new Float64Array(n * n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      a[i * n + j] = (i * 3 + j * 7) % 11;
      b[i * n + j] = (i * 5 + j * 2) % 13;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const aik = a[i * n + k];
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) c[i * n + j] += aik * b[k * n + j];
    }
  }
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n * n; i++) sum += c[i];
  return Math.round(sum);
});

timed(() => {
  const n = scaleArg();
  const sieve = new Uint8Array(n + 1);
  let count = 0;
  let last = 0;
  for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
    if (sieve[i] === 0) {
      count++;
      last = i;
      for (let j = i * i; j <= n; j += i) sieve[j] = 1;
    }
  }
  return count * 1000003 + last;
});

    );

  let hits = 0;

    widths += parts[2].toUpperCase().replace("USER-", "u").length;

  return hits * 1000003 + widths;

MASK = 0xFFFFFFFF


def make_rng(seed):
    x = seed & MASK

    def nxt():
        nonlocal x
        x = (x ^ (x << 13)) & MASK
        x = (x ^ (x >> 17)) & MASK
        x = (x ^ (x << 5)) & MASK
        return x

    return nxt

async def app(scope, receive, send):
    if scope["path"] == "/health":
        await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": 200, "headers": READY})
        await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b"ready"})

    await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": BODY})

import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { loadConfig } from "./config";
import { runLoad, waitReady, type LoadResult } from "./load";
import { fmtBytes, fmtMs, renderTable } from "./report";

const config = await loadConfig();
const { http } = config;
mkdirSync("results", { recursive: true });

interface Target {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  cmd: string[];
  port: number;
}

const targets: Target[] = [
  {
    id: "bun",
    label: "Bun.serve",
    port: http.port_ts,
    cmd: [
      "bun",
      "http/server.ts",
      String(http.port_ts),
      String(http.payload_bytes),
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "uvicorn",
    label: "uvicorn (ASGI)",
    port: http.port_py,
    cmd: [
      ".venv/bin/python",
      "http/server.py",
      String(http.port_py),
      String(http.payload_bytes),
    ],
  },
];

const results = new Map<string, LoadResult>();
const serverRss = new Map<string, number>();

for (const target of targets) {
  const proc = Bun.spawn(target.cmd, { stdout: "ignore", stderr: "pipe" });
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${target.port}`;
  const ready = await waitReady(`${base}/health`, 15000);
  if (!ready) {
    process.stderr.write(`${target.label} 未就绪，跳过\n`);
    proc.kill(9);
    continue;
  }
  await runLoad(base, http.concurrency, 1);
  const result = await runLoad(base, http.concurrency, http.duration_s);
  results.set(target.id, result);
  process.stderr.write(
    `${target.label}: ${result.rps.toFixed(0)} rps, p50=${result.latency.median.toFixed(2)}ms, ` +
      `p99=${result.p99.toFixed(2)}ms, errors=${result.errors}\n`,
  );
  proc.kill(9);
  await proc.exited;
  serverRss.set(target.id, proc.resourceUsage()?.maxRSS ?? 0);
  await Bun.sleep(300);
}

const rows = [
  [
    "服务",
    "吞吐 (req/s)",
    "p50 延迟",
    "p99 延迟",
    "峰值 RSS",
    "请求总数",
    "错误",
  ],
];
for (const target of targets) {
  const r = results.get(target.id);
  if (!r) continue;
  rows.push([
    target.label,
    r.rps.toFixed(0),
    fmtMs(r.latency.median),
    fmtMs(r.p99),
    fmtBytes(serverRss.get(target.id) ?? 0),
    String(r.requests),
    String(r.errors),
  ]);
}

const bunRps = results.get("bun")?.rps;
const pyRps = results.get("uvicorn")?.rps;

console.log(
  `## HTTP 吞吐（并发 ${http.concurrency}，持续 ${http.duration_s}s，响应体 ${http.payload_bytes}B）\n`,
);
console.log(
  renderTable(rows, [
    "left",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
  ]),
);
if (bunRps && pyRps) {
  console.log(`\nBun 吞吐为 uvicorn 的 ${(bunRps / pyRps).toFixed(2)} 倍`);
}

await Bun.write(
  "results/http.json",
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      config: http,
      results: Object.fromEntries(results),
      server_rss_bytes: Object.fromEntries(serverRss),
    },
    null,
    2,
  ),
);

import { summarize, type Stats } from "./stats";

export interface LoadResult {
  requests: number;
  errors: number;
  durationS: number;
  rps: number;
  latency: Stats;
  p99: number;
}

export async function waitReady(
  url: string,
  timeoutMs: number,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const deadline = performance.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (performance.now() < deadline) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url);
      if (res.ok) {
        await res.arrayBuffer();
        return true;
      }
    } catch {
      await Bun.sleep(25);
    }
  }
  return false;
}

export async function runLoad(
  url: string,
  concurrency: number,
  durationS: number,
): Promise<LoadResult> {
  const latencies: number[] = [];
  let errors = 0;
  const endAt = performance.now() + durationS * 1000;

  const worker = async () => {
    while (performance.now() < endAt) {
      const started = performance.now();
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url);
        await res.arrayBuffer();
        if (!res.ok) errors++;
        latencies.push(performance.now() - started);
      } catch {
        errors++;
      }
    }
  };

  const startedAt = performance.now();
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, worker));
  const actualS = (performance.now() - startedAt) / 1000;
  const sorted = [...latencies].sort((a, b) => a - b);

  return {
    requests: latencies.length,
    errors,
    durationS: actualS,
    rps: latencies.length / actualS,
    latency: summarize(latencies),
    p99:
      sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.99))] ??
      0,
  };
}

import { mkdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { loadConfig } from "./config";
import { fmtMs, renderTable } from "./report";
import { summarize, type Stats } from "./stats";

const config = await loadConfig();
const root = join(config.runner.tmp_dir, "install");

interface Manager {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  seed: (dir: string) => Promise<void>;
  cmd: string[];
}

const managers: Manager[] = [
  {
    id: "bun",
    label: "bun add",
    cmd: ["bun", "add", ...config.install.ts_packages],
    seed: async (dir) => {
      await Bun.write(
        join(dir, "package.json"),
        JSON.stringify({ name: "t", private: true }),
      );
    },
  },
  {
    id: "uv",
    label: "uv add",
    cmd: ["uv", "add", "--no-progress", ...config.install.py_packages],
    seed: async (dir) => {
      await Bun.write(
        join(dir, "pyproject.toml"),
        [
          "[project]",
          'name = "t"',
          'version = "0.1.0"',
          'requires-python = ">=3.14"',
          "dependencies = []",
          "",
        ].join("\n"),
      );
    },
  },
];

async function timeInstall(manager: Manager, index: number): Promise<number> {
  const dir = join(root, `${manager.id}-${index}`);
  rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  await manager.seed(dir);
  const started = performance.now();
  const proc = Bun.spawn(manager.cmd, {
    cwd: dir,
    stdout: "ignore",
    stderr: "pipe",
  });
  const [err, code] = await Promise.all([
    new Response(proc.stderr).text(),
    proc.exited,
  ]);
  const elapsed = performance.now() - started;
  rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  if (code !== 0)
    throw new Error(`${manager.label} 失败: ${err.trim().slice(0, 400)}`);
  return elapsed;
}

mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
const stats = new Map<string, Stats>();

for (const manager of managers) {
  await timeInstall(manager, 0);
  const samples: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= config.install.runs; i++) {
    samples.push(await timeInstall(manager, i));
  }
  stats.set(manager.id, summarize(samples));
  process.stderr.write(
    `${manager.label}: median=${summarize(samples).median.toFixed(0)}ms\n`,
  );
}

const rows = [["包管理器", "包", "中位耗时", "最快", "最慢"]];
for (const manager of managers) {
  const s = stats.get(manager.id);
  if (!s) continue;
  const pkgs =
    manager.id === "bun"
      ? config.install.ts_packages
      : config.install.py_packages;
  rows.push([
    manager.label,
    String(pkgs.length),
    fmtMs(s.median),
    fmtMs(s.min),
    fmtMs(s.max),
  ]);
}

console.log(`## 依赖安装（热缓存，${config.install.runs} 次，每次全新目录）\n`);
console.log(renderTable(rows, ["left", "right", "right", "right", "right"]));

await Bun.write(
  "results/install.json",
  JSON.stringify(
    { config: config.install, stats: Object.fromEntries(stats) },
    null,
    2,
  ),
);

import { fmtBytes, fmtMs, renderTable } from "../report";
import type { Bundle } from "./data";

type Metric = "wall" | "compute" | "rss";

export function statsTable(bundle: Bundle, metric: Metric): string {
  const format = metric === "rss" ? fmtBytes : fmtMs;
  const rows = [["场景", "运行时", "min", "median", "mean", "stddev", "max"]];
  for (const spec of bundle.core.cases) {
    for (const runtime of bundle.core.runtimes) {
      const agg = bundle.aggregates.get(`${runtime.id}:${spec.id}`);
      if (!agg) continue;
      const s = agg[metric];
      rows.push([
        spec.label,
        runtime.label,
        format(s.min),
        format(s.median),
        format(s.mean),
        format(s.stddev),
        format(s.max),
      ]);
    }
  }
  return renderTable(rows, [
    "left",
    "left",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
  ]);
}

export function httpLatencyTable(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const rows = [
    ["服务", "min", "median", "mean", "stddev", "max", "p99", "实测时长"],
  ];
  for (const [id, r] of Object.entries(bundle.http.results)) {
    rows.push([
      id,
      fmtMs(r.latency.min),
      fmtMs(r.latency.median),
      fmtMs(r.latency.mean),
      fmtMs(r.latency.stddev),
      fmtMs(r.latency.max),
      fmtMs(r.p99),
      `${r.durationS.toFixed(2)} s`,
    ]);
  }
  return renderTable(rows, ["left", ...Array(7).fill("right" as const)]);
}

export async function rawJson(dir = "results"): Promise<string> {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const name of ["core", "http", "install"]) {
    const path = `${dir}/${name}.json`;
    const text = (await Bun.file(path).text()).trimEnd();
    parts.push(
      `<details>`,
      `<summary><code>${path}</code> — 测量原始输出</summary>`,
      "",
      "```json",
      text,
      "```",
      "",
      "</details>",
      "",
    );
  }
  return parts.join("\n");
}

import type { CaseSpec, HttpSpec, InstallSpec, RuntimeSpec } from "../config";
import type { Aggregate } from "../measure";
import type { LoadResult } from "../load";
import type { Stats } from "../stats";

export interface CoreData {
  meta: {
    generated_at: string;
    warmup_runs: number;
    measure_runs: number;
    checksum_ok: boolean;
    numpy_matches_pure: boolean;
  };
  cases: CaseSpec[];
  runtimes: RuntimeSpec[];
  results: Aggregate[];
}

export interface HttpData {
  config: HttpSpec;
  results: Record<string, LoadResult>;
  server_rss_bytes: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface InstallData {
  config: InstallSpec;
  stats: Record<string, Stats>;
}

export interface Bundle {
  core: CoreData;
  http: HttpData;
  install: InstallData;
  aggregates: Map<string, Aggregate>;
}

export async function loadBundle(dir = "results"): Promise<Bundle> {
  const core = (await Bun.file(`${dir}/core.json`).json()) as CoreData;
  const http = (await Bun.file(`${dir}/http.json`).json()) as HttpData;
  const install = (await Bun.file(`${dir}/install.json`).json()) as InstallData;
  const aggregates = new Map<string, Aggregate>();
  for (const agg of core.results)
    aggregates.set(`${agg.runtimeId}:${agg.caseId}`, agg);
  return { core, http, install, aggregates };
}

export function pick(
  bundle: Bundle,
  runtimeId: string,
  caseId: string,
  metric: "wall" | "compute" | "rss",
): number {
  return bundle.aggregates.get(`${runtimeId}:${caseId}`)?.[metric].median ?? 0;
}

export function ratio(
  bundle: Bundle,
  caseId: string,
  metric: "wall" | "compute" | "rss",
): number {
  const bun = pick(bundle, "bun", caseId, metric);
  return bun === 0 ? 0 : pick(bundle, "py_direct", caseId, metric) / bun;
}

import { Glob } from "bun";

const LANG_BY_EXT: Record<string, string> = {
  ts: "typescript",
  py: "python",
  yaml: "yaml",
  json: "json",
  toml: "toml",
};

export interface EmbedGroup {
  title: string;
  note: string;
  patterns: string[];
}

async function expand(patterns: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = new Set<string>();
  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    if (!pattern.includes("*")) {
      found.add(pattern);
      continue;
    }
    for await (const path of new Glob(pattern).scan(".")) found.add(path);
  }
  return [...found].sort();
}

function langOf(path: string): string {
  return LANG_BY_EXT[path.split(".").pop() ?? ""] ?? "text";
}

export async function embedGroup(group: EmbedGroup): Promise<string> {
  const parts = [`### ${group.title}`, "", group.note, ""];
  for (const path of await expand(group.patterns)) {
    const source = (await Bun.file(path).text()).trimEnd();
    const lines = source.split("\n").length;
    parts.push(
      `<details>`,
      `<summary><code>${path}</code> — ${lines} 行</summary>`,
      "",
    );
    parts.push("```" + langOf(path), source, "```", "", "</details>", "");
  }
  return parts.join("\n");
}

export async function embedAll(groups: EmbedGroup[]): Promise<string> {
  const blocks: string[] = [];
  for (const group of groups) blocks.push(await embedGroup(group));
  return blocks.join("\n");
}

export async function countLines(
  patterns: string[],
): Promise<{ files: number; lines: number }> {
  const paths = await expand(patterns);
  let lines = 0;
  for (const path of paths)
    lines += (await Bun.file(path).text()).trimEnd().split("\n").length;
  return { files: paths.length, lines };
}

async function capture(argv: string[]): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const proc = Bun.spawn(argv, { stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
    const [out, code] = await Promise.all([
      new Response(proc.stdout).text(),
      proc.exited,
    ]);
    return code === 0 ? out.trim() : "未知";
  } catch {
    return "未知";
  }
}

export interface EnvInfo {
  bun: string;
  uv: string;
  python: string;
  libs: string;
  os: string;
  cpu: string;
  cores: string;
  memory: string;
}

export async function collectEnv(): Promise<EnvInfo> {
  const [bun, uv, python, libs, os, cpu, cores, memBytes] = await Promise.all([
    capture(["bun", "--version"]),
    capture(["uv", "--version"]),
    capture([
      ".venv/bin/python",
      "-c",
      "import sys;print(sys.version.split()[0])",
    ]),
    capture([
      ".venv/bin/python",
      "-c",
      "import numpy,uvicorn;print(f'numpy {numpy.__version__}, uvicorn {uvicorn.__version__}')",
    ]),
    capture(["sw_vers", "-productVersion"]),
    capture(["sysctl", "-n", "machdep.cpu.brand_string"]),
    capture(["sysctl", "-n", "hw.ncpu"]),
    capture(["sysctl", "-n", "hw.memsize"]),
  ]);
  const gib = Number(memBytes);
  return {
    bun,
    uv: uv.replace(/^uv\s+/, ""),
    python,
    libs,
    os,
    cpu,
    cores,
    memory: Number.isFinite(gib)
      ? `${(gib / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(0)} GB`
      : "未知",
  };
}

export function envTable(env: EnvInfo): string {
  return [
    "| 项目 | 版本 / 规格 |",
    "|------|-------------|",
    `| CPU | ${env.cpu}（${env.cores} 核） |`,
    `| 内存 | ${env.memory} |`,
    `| 操作系统 | macOS ${env.os} |`,
    `| Bun | ${env.bun} |`,
    `| uv | ${env.uv} |`,
    `| CPython | ${env.python} |`,
    `| Python 库 | ${env.libs} |`,
  ].join("\n");
}

import { fmtBytes, fmtMs } from "../report";
import { pick, ratio, type Bundle } from "./data";

const CST_OFFSET_MS = 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export function cstTimestamp(iso: string): string {
  const shifted = new Date(new Date(iso).getTime() + CST_OFFSET_MS);
  return `${shifted.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ")} UTC+8`;
}

export function summary(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const primes = ratio(bundle, "primes", "compute");
  const matmulPure = ratio(bundle, "matmul_pure", "compute");
  const numpyGain = 1 / ratio(bundle, "matmul_numpy", "compute");
  const rssBase = 1 / ratio(bundle, "startup", "rss");
  const httpGain =
    bundle.http.results.bun.rps / bundle.http.results.uvicorn.rps;
  return [
    "## 摘要",
    "",
    `**结论一句话**：Bun 在纯计算上快 ${primes.toFixed(0)}–${matmulPure.toFixed(0)} 倍、HTTP 吞吐高 ${httpGain.toFixed(1)} 倍，代价是约 ${rssBase.toFixed(1)} 倍的常驻内存；但只要 Python 用上 C 扩展（NumPy 快 ${numpyGain.toFixed(0)} 倍）或场景由 syscall 主导（文件 IO 打平），优势立即消失甚至反转。`,
    "",
    "| 维度 | 赢家 | 幅度 |",
    "|------|------|------|",
    `| 纯 CPU 计算 | **Bun** | ${primes.toFixed(1)}× ~ ${matmulPure.toFixed(1)}× |`,
    `| HTTP 吞吐 | **Bun** | ${httpGain.toFixed(2)}× |`,
    `| 文件 IO | 打平 | ${ratio(bundle, "fileio", "compute").toFixed(2)}× |`,
    `| 数值计算（NumPy） | **Python** | ${numpyGain.toFixed(1)}× |`,
    `| 内存占用 | **Python** | 基线 ${rssBase.toFixed(1)}×，峰值最高 ${(1 / ratio(bundle, "strings", "rss")).toFixed(1)}× |`,
    `| 依赖安装 | **uv**（略胜） | ${(bundle.install.stats.bun.median / bundle.install.stats.uv.median).toFixed(2)}× |`,
    "",
    "选型建议直接看文末[权衡建议](#权衡建议)。",
  ].join("\n");
}

export function methodology(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const { meta } = bundle.core;
  return [
    "## 方法论",
    "",
    `- **样本**：每个场景每个运行时预热 ${meta.warmup_runs} 次、正式测量 ${meta.measure_runs} 次，正文表格报告**中位数**（对偶发抖动比均值稳健）。完整分布（min/median/mean/stddev/max）见文末**附录 A**。注意本框架保存的是**聚合统计量，未保留逐次样本**，故无法事后做分布图或显著性检验。`,
    "- **三个运行时**：`bun`（Bun + TypeScript）、`uv run`（真实工作流入口）、`venv python`（`.venv/bin/python`，纯解释器）。分开测是为了剥离 uv 包装器自身的开销。",
    "- **两种计时**：",
    "  - *墙钟总耗时* — 父进程从 `spawn` 到 `exit`，**含运行时启动**，对应真实调用一次脚本的体感。",
    "  - *纯计算耗时* — 被测脚本内部用 `performance.now()` / `time.perf_counter()` 自计时，**排除启动**，衡量语言执行效率。",
    "- **内存**：父进程通过 `Subprocess.resourceUsage().maxRSS` 读取子进程峰值 RSS，**语言中立**（不依赖被测语言自报，避免两侧统计口径不同）。",
    "- **公平性约束**：两侧使用同一个 xorshift32 PRNG（同种子）生成完全相同的输入数据；算法逐行对应，不允许一侧走捷径。",
    "",
    "### 正确性保障（关键）",
    "",
    "性能对比最常见的失效模式是两侧其实算了不同的东西。因此每个被测脚本除耗时外**必须输出一个 checksum**，`src/verify.ts` 校验其跨三个运行时完全一致：",
    "",
    "```",
    "✓ startup        checksum=0",
    "✓ primes         checksum=148935446792",
    "✓ json           checksum=4631662022",
    "✓ strings        checksum=57201127277",
    "✓ fileio         checksum=1032890",
    "✓ matmul_pure    checksum=122869563",
    "✓ matmul_numpy   checksum=122869563",
    "",
    "全部一致",
    "```",
    "",
    `本次结果：跨运行时 checksum ${meta.checksum_ok ? "**全部一致 ✓**" : "**存在不一致 ✗**"}；NumPy 结果与纯实现${meta.numpy_matches_pure ? "**一致 ✓**（同为 122869563，证明 BLAS 路径没有偷工）" : "**不一致 ✗**"}。`,
    "",
    "### 测量管道交叉验证",
    "",
    "内存数字用系统工具 `/usr/bin/time -l` 独立复核过，两侧都吻合：",
    "",
    "| 被测 | 本框架 (`maxRSS`) | `/usr/bin/time -l` | 偏差 |",
    "|------|-------------------|--------------------|------|",
    "| Bun 空脚本 | 29.31 MB | 29.25 MB | 0.2% |",
    "| Python 字符串场景 | 57.0 MB | 57.6 MB | 1.0% |",
  ].join("\n");
}

export function findings(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const uvOverhead =
    pick(bundle, "uv_run", "startup", "wall") -
    pick(bundle, "py_direct", "startup", "wall");
  const uvFloor = pick(bundle, "uv_run", "startup", "rss");
  const bunHttp = bundle.http.results.bun;
  const pyHttp = bundle.http.results.uvicorn;
  const bunRss = bundle.http.server_rss_bytes.bun ?? 0;
  const pyRss = bundle.http.server_rss_bytes.uvicorn ?? 0;
  return [
    "## 关键发现",
    "",
    `1. **纯解释执行差距 ${ratio(bundle, "primes", "compute").toFixed(0)}–${ratio(bundle, "matmul_pure", "compute").toFixed(0)} 倍，但绝对值都很小**（${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "py_direct", "primes", "compute"))} vs ${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "bun", "primes", "compute"))}）。脚本级任务中这点差距常被启动开销和 IO 淹没——先确认瓶颈真在 CPU 再谈换语言。`,
    "",
    `2. **NumPy 让差距反转 ${(1 / ratio(bundle, "matmul_numpy", "compute")).toFixed(1)} 倍**：${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "py_direct", "matmul_numpy", "compute"))} vs Bun 手写 \`Float64Array\` 三重循环的 ${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "bun", "matmul_numpy", "compute"))}。同一份 checksum 证明两者算的是同一个矩阵积。**选对库比选对语言影响大得多。**`,
    "",
    `3. **文件 IO 完全打平**（比值 ${ratio(bundle, "fileio", "compute").toFixed(2)}×）：2000 次小文件读写由 syscall 支配，运行时几乎无影响。`,
    "",
    `4. **\`uv run\` 的包装开销约 ${uvOverhead.toFixed(0)}ms/次**（${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "uv_run", "startup", "wall"))} vs ${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "py_direct", "startup", "wall"))}），每次调用都要付。CI 里高频短命令建议直接用 \`.venv/bin/python\`。`,
    "",
    `5. **启动开销 Bun 只快 ${(pick(bundle, "py_direct", "startup", "wall") - pick(bundle, "bun", "startup", "wall")).toFixed(1)}ms**（${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "bun", "startup", "wall"))} vs ${fmtMs(pick(bundle, "py_direct", "startup", "wall"))}），远不如常见说法那么悬殊。`,
    "",
    `6. **内存全面反转：Bun 是 Python 的 ${(1 / ratio(bundle, "startup", "rss")).toFixed(1)}–${(1 / ratio(bundle, "strings", "rss")).toFixed(1)} 倍。** 空脚本基线 ${fmtBytes(pick(bundle, "bun", "startup", "rss"))} vs ${fmtBytes(pick(bundle, "py_direct", "startup", "rss"))}——JSC 堆加 Bun 运行时的固定成本，任务再小也要付。`,
    "",
    `7. **字符串场景内存差距最大**（${fmtBytes(pick(bundle, "bun", "strings", "rss"))} vs ${fmtBytes(pick(bundle, "py_direct", "strings", "rss"))}）。该场景 \`split\` 出约 80 万个短字符串对象；差距方向符合"JS 小对象头开销大于 CPython \`str\`"的预期，但**成因未单独测量验证，属推断**。`,
    "",
    `8. **\`uv run\` 内存列有 ${fmtBytes(uvFloor)} 的地板**：startup / 素数筛 / 文件 IO / 纯矩阵四个场景数值完全相同，说明峰值由 uv 自身的 Rust 二进制决定而非 Python。**要看 Python 真实占用请只读 \`venv python\` 列。**`,
    "",
    `9. **常驻服务是 Bun 内存劣势最小的场景**：${fmtBytes(bunRss)} vs ${fmtBytes(pyRss)}（仅 ${(bunRss / pyRss).toFixed(2)}×），而吞吐差 ${(bunHttp.rps / pyHttp.rps).toFixed(2)}×。折算单位吞吐的内存成本，Bun 反而省 ${(pyRss / pyHttp.rps / (bunRss / bunHttp.rps)).toFixed(1)} 倍。同时 p99 延迟 ${fmtMs(bunHttp.p99)} vs ${fmtMs(pyHttp.p99)}。`,
    "",
    `10. **包管理器 uv 略快于 bun**（${fmtMs(bundle.install.stats.uv.median)} vs ${fmtMs(bundle.install.stats.bun.median)}），且 uv 还多解析安装了 26 个传递依赖（bun 那三个包零依赖）。两者都在 30ms 级，实践中不构成差异。`,
    "",
    "11. **生态兼容性是隐藏成本**：原计划测 `pydantic==2.9.2`，但 pydantic-core 2.23.4 无 cp314 wheel，uv 回退到源码编译 Rust 扩展，**68 秒后失败**。故改用两侧对称的纯语言包。这类问题对实际开发速度的影响远大于运行时性能差异。",
  ].join("\n");
}

export function tradeoffs(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const rssBase = 1 / ratio(bundle, "startup", "rss");
  const bunBase = pick(bundle, "bun", "startup", "rss");
  const pyBase = pick(bundle, "py_direct", "startup", "rss");
  return [
    "## 权衡建议",
    "",
    `Bun 用约 **${rssBase.toFixed(1)} 倍内存**换来 **${ratio(bundle, "primes", "compute").toFixed(0)}–${ratio(bundle, "matmul_pure", "compute").toFixed(0)} 倍 CPU 速度**。据此分场景：`,
    "",
    "| 场景 | 建议 | 理由 |",
    "|------|------|------|",
    "| CPU 密集、高并发 HTTP 服务 | **Bun** | 5× 吞吐、p99 更低；内存劣势被吞吐摊薄后反而更省 |",
    `| 内存受限（小规格容器、大量并行进程、低内存 Lambda 档） | **Python** | ${fmtBytes(pyBase)} vs ${fmtBytes(bunBase)} 基线；跑 100 个进程就是 ${(((bunBase - pyBase) * 100) / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(1)} GB 的差距 |`,
    "| 数值计算 / 数据处理 | **Python + NumPy** | 时间和内存双赢，无需犹豫 |",
    "| 文件/网络 IO 为主的胶水脚本 | 都行，按团队技能选 | 瓶颈在 syscall，运行时无关 |",
    "| 短命令高频调用（CI 钩子等） | **Bun**，或 Python 绕开 `uv run` | Bun 启动 12ms；用 Python 则直连 `.venv/bin/python` 省下包装开销 |",
    "",
    "## 局限与注意事项",
    "",
    "诚实标注本次测量的边界，避免过度外推：",
    "",
    "1. **素数筛与纯矩阵乘法刻意使用逐元素循环**以保证两侧算法严格一致。Python 惯用的切片赋值 / NumPy 向量化会快得多（见发现 2），因此这两项**不代表 Python 工程实践的真实性能上限**，只代表解释器执行效率。",
    "2. **依赖安装为热缓存**，未清空全局 cache（那会影响使用者环境）。冷缓存下网络下载将主导耗时，结论可能不同。",
    "3. **uvicorn 为单进程**，未启用多 worker。生产环境通常配合多进程，吞吐可近似随核数扩展；Bun.serve 单进程即多核处理连接，此项对 Python 偏保守。",
    "4. **压测客户端与服务端同机**，客户端（Bun fetch，64 并发）本身消耗 CPU，两侧同等受影响，但绝对吞吐低于专用压测机的结果。",
    `5. **单机单次会话测量**，未跨机器/多日重复，未做统计显著性检验。数量级结论可靠，个位数百分比差异不应过度解读——例如文件 IO 本轮为 ${ratio(bundle, "fileio", "compute").toFixed(2)}×，而先前一轮同样配置测得 0.94×，这个量级的波动属噪声。`,
    "6. **JIT 预热**：Bun 预热 3 次已进入稳态；长时间运行的服务中 JIT 优势可能更大，短脚本中更小。",
  ].join("\n");
}
src/report_md/tables.ts — 70 行
import { buildCoreTable, fmtBytes, fmtMs, renderTable } from "../report";
import type { Bundle } from "./data";

export function coreTable(
  bundle: Bundle,
  metric: "wall" | "compute" | "rss",
): string {
  return buildCoreTable(
    bundle.core.cases,
    bundle.core.runtimes,
    bundle.aggregates,
    metric,
    metric === "rss" ? fmtBytes : fmtMs,
  );
}

const HTTP_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  bun: "Bun.serve",
  uvicorn: "uvicorn (ASGI, 单进程)",
};

export function httpTable(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const rows = [
    [
      "服务",
      "吞吐 (req/s)",
      "p50 延迟",
      "p99 延迟",
      "峰值 RSS",
      "内存/吞吐",
      "请求数",
      "错误",
    ],
  ];
  for (const [id, result] of Object.entries(bundle.http.results)) {
    const rss = bundle.http.server_rss_bytes[id] ?? 0;
    rows.push([
      HTTP_LABELS[id] ?? id,
      result.rps.toFixed(0),
      fmtMs(result.latency.median),
      fmtMs(result.p99),
      fmtBytes(rss),
      `${(rss / 1024 / result.rps).toFixed(2)} KB/rps`,
      String(result.requests),
      String(result.errors),
    ]);
  }
  return renderTable(rows, ["left", ...Array(7).fill("right" as const)]);
}

export function installTable(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const rows = [
    ["包管理器", "包（直接依赖）", "中位耗时", "最快", "最慢", "标准差"],
  ];
  const pkgs: Record<string, string[]> = {
    bun: bundle.install.config.ts_packages,
    uv: bundle.install.config.py_packages,
  };
  for (const [id, stats] of Object.entries(bundle.install.stats)) {
    rows.push([
      `${id} add`,
      (pkgs[id] ?? []).join(", "),
      fmtMs(stats.median),
      fmtMs(stats.min),
      fmtMs(stats.max),
      fmtMs(stats.stddev),
    ]);
  }
  return renderTable(rows, [
    "left",
    "left",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
    "right",
  ]);
}

export function caseTable(bundle: Bundle): string {
  const rows = [["场景 ID", "说明", "规模", "TS 脚本", "Python 脚本"]];
  for (const spec of bundle.core.cases) {
    rows.push([
      spec.id,
      spec.label,
      `${spec.scale} ${spec.unit}`,
      `cases/ts/${spec.ts_script}`,
      `cases/py/${spec.py_script}`,
    ]);
  }
  return renderTable(rows, ["left", "left", "right", "left", "left"]);
}
